s.d: the roaring sound made by a motor that is running at high speed
The sound of an engine revving up.
x: Our ears are assaulted with the screeching of tires, the crashing of trash cans, the exaggerated vrooms of a revving engine.

s.d: make a loud, roaring sound, as of a car engine, while moving
(informal) To move with great speed; to zoom.
The sound of an engine, especially when it is revving up.
x: I never saw my uncle’s Ferrari, but I could always hear it going vroom as it flew past by my house.
